title: Ambani's Jio seeks to raise $3.2B in what could be India's biggest IPO | TechCrunch
summary: In the quarter ended June, Jio’s revenue rose nearly 12% from a year earlier to ₹391.7 billion (about $4.1 billion), while its net profit climbed 9% to ₹77.6 billion (around $816 million), per its IPO prospectus (PDF).
